BiblicalUsage: Beth-Ashtaroth means "house of Ashtaroth." It was a Philistine temple. You will find it in 1 Samuel 31:10.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that Beth-Ashtaroth is worth knowing, because God's people actually walked there.
